title: Cooking on the River: Episode 2
contentHtml:
We begin our four-day journey down whitewater rapids. Now, with no refrigeration and 25 mouths to feed, our challenge truly begins!

We're back with Episode 2 of Cooking on the River! In Episode 1, we arrived in Moab, met the crew, and grabbed some local produce for the trip. Today, we're packing up our rafts and setting off down the Colorado River.

If you haven't been following the series thus far, you might be wondering how we ended up here to begin with. We were invited to participate in the final event of the Moab Music Festival where, over four days, we traveled down whitewater rapids with Sheri Griffith River Expedition guides. Classical musicians brought carbon fiber instruments to keep the 25 guests entertained and we brought coolers of food to keep them fed.

It was truly the adventure—and challenge—of a lifetime, and it's made all the more rewarding by being able to bring you at home along for the ride. We hope you enjoy Episode 2!

P.S. Patreon members will also be receiving all the recipes we cooked on our trip. You can already find two dishes (a Melon & Shiso Salad and Stir-Fried Shrimp & Grits) in the Cooking on the River collection.
